events.subtitle: Ripples in the Water: Philip Glass at 90

venue.name: Zellerbach Theatre at the Annenberg Center

events.category: Contemporary percussion / Philip Glass at 90 / Special collaboration
events.factual_description: Penn Live Arts presents Third Coast Percussion with Glenn Kotche on Sunday, February 7, 2027 at Zellerbach Theatre at the Annenberg Center in Philadelphia. Third Coast Percussion identifies the engagement as the ensemble's Philadelphia debut and a special edition of Ripples in the Water: Philip Glass at 90. The published program includes music by Devonté Hynes, Jlin, Steve Reich, David Skidmore and Philip Glass, with Reich's Music for Pieces of Wood arranged for two drum sets by Glenn Kotche and a Kotche solo work also planned. The Glass portion centers on Third Coast Percussion's arrangements from Aguas da Amazonia and Metamorphosis. A reliable local showtime was not independently verified in this pass, so none is recorded.

en.why_it_matters: This feels more like a percussion genealogy than a birthday tribute. Third Coast Percussion's relationship with Glass includes commissioning Perpetulum, while the Philadelphia version pulls Glenn Kotche into the same frame and lets his two-drum-set Reich arrangement push the program toward a different kind of physical rhythm. The ensemble's Philadelphia debut, the special guest and the Glass-at-90 architecture make this a specifically strong regional date rather than generic contemporary-classical touring inventory.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for it if Philadelphia is in range and percussion, minimalism or rhythm-as-composition sit near the center of the listening thread. The Glass-at-90 program travels widely in early 2027, so I would build a Philadelphia day or night around this version rather than rebuild a larger trip solely for one date.

es.why_it_matters: Esto se siente más como una genealogía de la percusión que como un simple homenaje de cumpleaños. La relación de Third Coast Percussion con Glass incluye haberle encargado Perpetulum, mientras la versión de Filadelfia mete a Glenn Kotche en el mismo marco y deja que su arreglo de Reich para dos baterías empuje el programa hacia otra clase de fuerza rítmica. El debut del ensamble en Filadelfia, el invitado especial y la arquitectura Glass-at-90 vuelven esta fecha regionalmente muy fuerte sin convertirla en inventario genérico de gira contemporánea.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente si Filadelfia queda a tiro y la percusión, el minimalismo o el ritmo como composición están en el centro del hilo de escucha. El programa Glass-at-90 gira bastante a comienzos de 2027, así que construiría un día o una noche en Filadelfia alrededor de esta versión, no rehacería un viaje mayor únicamente por una fecha.

events.subtitle: Vernacular
events.factual_description: Jlin and Third Coast Percussion bring Vernacular to Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall on Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM. Third Coast Percussion's official 2026-2027 announcement describes Vernacular as a touring program built from the collaborators' decade-long relationship, with Jlin performing live electronics alongside acoustic percussion realizations of her music and new works composed for all five performers. The same official season announcement identifies the exact Carnegie date, time and Zankel Hall venue. Vernacular premiered in February 2026 and tours extensively in Europe and the United States before and after the Carnegie engagement.

en.why_it_matters: The point is not electronic artist plus chamber ensemble as crossover branding. Jlin's polyrhythmic logic has already been translated into acoustic percussion by Third Coast Percussion; Vernacular puts her electronics and that acoustic language onstage together and adds music written specifically for all five performers. In Zankel, the collision should be unusually physical and detailed at the same time: club-derived rhythmic thinking moving through a chamber-music listening environment.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for it in a New York trip if electronic rhythm, percussion and contemporary composition are central to the listening thread. Vernacular is touring internationally and returns to multiple U.S. stages in spring 2027, so Carnegie is a particularly strong presentation of the project rather than a scarcity-tier one-off.

es.why_it_matters: La gracia no es vender como crossover a una artista electrónica junto a un ensamble de cámara. La lógica polirrítmica de Jlin ya ha sido traducida a percusión acústica por Third Coast Percussion; Vernacular pone ahora su electrónica y ese lenguaje acústico juntos en el escenario y añade música escrita específicamente para los cinco intérpretes. En Zankel, el choque puede ser muy físico y muy detallado a la vez: pensamiento rítmico nacido del club pasando por un espacio de escucha de música de cámara.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente dentro de un viaje a Nueva York si el ritmo electrónico, la percusión y la composición contemporánea están en el centro del hilo de escucha. Vernacular gira internacionalmente y vuelve a varias salas estadounidenses en la primavera de 2027, así que Carnegie es una presentación particularmente fuerte del proyecto, no un one-off de categoría de escasez.
